content_fields.title: Verify that image vulnerability scanning is enabled (Docker)
content_fields.description: Verify that image vulnerability scanning is enabled and gating.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming scan results exist for the current image, that they are recent, and that pushing an image with a high-severity finding is blocked.
content_fields.found: No scan results are produced for this project.
content_fields.missing: The scanning platform and its reports.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification depends on a scanning service not yet in place.
content_fields.action: The container platform team should verify scanning coverage once it is enabled.
